answer: Give every key a distinct verification shard each epoch: a public beacon assigns it one random block range to re-execute, like a surveyor sent to walk a separate ridge. Each shard overlaps two other keys' ranges, so outputs are cross-checked. A farm cannot reuse one computation across clones, so 100 keys cost 100 full re-executions, and a key copying a neighbor fails the overlap. No key coasts as a relic of early work; pay rests on this epoch's knoll of checked shards.
